jobs.description:
Overview

At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. As a national leader in geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, and materials testing and inspection, we collaborate on transformative projects across transportation, energy, water, healthcare, and more. Learn more about the benefits of joining Team UES and our core values at careers.teamues.com.

Position Overview

The Field Staff Geologist is a primarily field-based role responsible for supporting subsurface investigations, environmental site assessments, and remediation projects through hands-on data collection and site oversight. Working under the direction of senior geologists and project managers, this position performs soil, groundwater, and rock logging activities; oversees drilling and sampling operations; and documents field conditions to support technical reporting and regulatory compliance.

Responsibilities

Assist with and perform field investigations including soil borings, test pits, monitoring well installations, and geologic site reconnaissance. - Log soil and rock borings in accordance with industry standards and established company procedures. - Collect soil, groundwater, surface water, and vapor samples following proper chain-of-custody protocols. - Oversee drilling subcontractors and remediation contractors to ensure adherence to project scope and safety standards. - Conduct groundwater monitoring, well gauging, and sampling events. - Perform Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) field activities. - Document site conditions, lithology, groundwater observations, and field screening results in detailed field notes. - Utilize field instruments (PID, water level meters, multi-parameter meters, etc.) and ensure proper calibration and maintenance. - Assist with site remediation oversight, including excavation monitoring and soil management activities. - Support preparation of technical reports, boring logs, figures, and regulatory documentation based on field findings. - Coordinate with subcontractors, laboratories, and project teams to ensure timely completion of field tasks. - Adhere strictly to safety protocols, including OSHA and HAZWOPER requirements, and properly utilize PPE. - Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Earth Sciences, or related field. - 0–2 years of relevant field experience (internships and academic fieldwork strongly preferred). - Fundamentals of Geology (FG) certification required; working toward Professional Geologist (PG) licensure if applicable by state. - OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER certification with current 8-hour refresher (as applicable). - Basic knowledge of soil classification, hydrogeology principles, and environmental site investigation techniques. - Willingness and ability to work in outdoor and physically demanding environments. - Ability to travel regularly to field sites. - Valid driver’s license with clean driving record. - Proficiency in Microsoft Office; familiarity with field logging software and GIS tools preferred. - Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to maintain accurate field documentation. - Effective verbal and written communication skills

Travel Requirements

This position requires extensive travel, approximately up to 70% of the time, in support of business objectives and client engagements. Travel may be both scheduled and on short notice, depending on project needs. Destinations typically include job sites, field locations, or regional offices, where work may be conducted in outdoor or operational environments. Adherence to all company safety protocols and use of PPE is required during travel and on-site work.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

Work is primarily conducted outdoors with exposure to outdoor conditions, including: - Sites that may not be accessible by vehicle, requiring travel on foot through wetlands, swamps, grasslands, construction zones, and other uneven or rugged terrain with natural and man-made obstacles such as sand, brush, and debris. - Moderate to loud noise levels due to lab equipment, field operations, and construction environments. - Exposure to dirt, dust, chemicals, sun, heat, humidity, and varying weather conditions as part of field sample collection and testing. - Physical requirements include: - Ability to lift and carry between 35 and 75 lbs. over distances up to 75 feet, involving regular repetitive motion. - Ability to stand, walk, drive, and operate laboratory and field equipment for extended periods. - Ability to bend, twist, reach, stoop, pull, kneel, climb, balance, lift, carry, and push as required for laboratory and fieldwork. - Ability to use visual, auditory, tactile, and olfactory senses, including near/far vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to focus. - Ability to communicate effectively through verbal and written means in a lab and field environment, often requiring the use of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment).

Have a clean Motor Vehicle Report in order to travel between restaurants
Be responsible for safe driving requirements as determined by the law
Have a B.A./B.S. in related field or an equivalent in education and experience with two (2) years formal or informal training on how to repair and maintain facilities; experience with restaurant equipment, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, refrigeration or appliance repair preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. Customer & Business Data Analyst II
jobs.description:
About Slickdeals:

We believe shopping should feel like winning. That's why 10 million people come to Slickdeals to swap tips, upvote the best finds, and share the thrill of a great deal. Together, our community has saved more than $10 billion over the past 26 years.

We're profitable, passionate, and in the middle of an exciting evolution—transforming from the internet's most trusted deal forum into the go-to daily shopping destination. If you thrive in a fast-moving, creative environment where ideas turn into impact fast, you'll fit right in.

The Purpose:

Slickdeals is looking for a Senior Customer & Business Data Analyst to join our Finance & Business Operations team. This is a high-visibility role that will help shape how we understand our business, our users, and the opportunities that will drive Slickdeals' long-term growth.

Reporting to the VP of Finance & Business Operations, you will work across some of the most important questions facing the company—from understanding changes in customer behavior and marketplace performance, to identifying business trends for senior leadership and the Board, to sizing new products, markets, and strategic opportunities.

We're looking for someone who goes well beyond reporting what happened. The right candidate is naturally curious, commercially minded, and proactive about identifying the questions that matter. You should be comfortable moving from raw data to a clear point of view:

What is happening? Why is it happening? Why does it matter? And what should we do about it?

This role will have significant exposure to Slickdeals' executive team and cross-functional leadership and will play an important part in informing the company's long-term strategy. You will have the opportunity to work with rich customer, deal, merchant, and transactional datasets and significant autonomy in determining where deeper analysis can create value.

What You'll Do:

Drive strategic and operational analysis.
Analyze customer, deal, merchant, product, financial, and external market data to identify the trends, risks, and opportunities most important to Slickdeals' performance and long-term strategy.
Develop a deep understanding of customer and marketplace behavior.
Evaluate changes in acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, customer value, merchant performance, and deal economics to understand not just what is changing, but why.
Size new products and growth opportunities.
Build data-driven assessments of new products, markets, customer segments, revenue streams, and strategic initiatives, translating ambiguous questions into clear analytical frameworks and recommendations.
Validate new and evolving data sources.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to understand how new products and features work, validate that underlying datasets and metrics accurately reflect real-world product behavior, and identify data quality or tracking issues before they influence business decisions.
Proactively identify and answer important business questions.
Go beyond responding to requests by surfacing anomalies, developing hypotheses, and independently pursuing analyses that can materially improve decisions. Leverage AI and other emerging tools where useful to accelerate deep analysis, dashboard development, and the path from question to action.
Influence decisions through clear communication.
Distill complex analyses into concise insights, recommendations, dashboards, and presentations for cross-functional leaders, senior executives, and the Board.

What We're Looking For:

7+ years of experience in business analytics, customer analytics, product analytics, strategy, business intelligence, finance analytics, or a similarly analytical and business-oriented role.
Advanced SQL skills and demonstrated ability to independently explore and analyze large, complex datasets.
Exceptional business judgment and an ability to connect analytical findings to customer behavior, underlying business economics, and broader strategic implications.
Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business questions, structure them analytically, identify the right data and methodology, and develop a clear recommendation or point of view.
A naturally curious and proactive mindset. You don't wait for someone to tell you exactly what analysis to run—you develop hypotheses, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities others may have missed.
Strong analytical storytelling skills, including the ability to distill a complex analysis into the few insights that actually matter.
Experience analyzing customer or user behavior, including areas such as acquisition, engagement, retention, conversion, segmentation, cohorts, or lifetime value.
Ability to move comfortably between highly detailed analyses and broad strategic questions.
Experience partnering directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders and using analytics to influence meaningful business decisions.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and BI tools such as Tableau or similar platforms and Excel / Google Sheets.
BS degree in economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, business, computer science, engineering, or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have:

Experience in a consumer internet, e-commerce, marketplace, digital media, affiliate marketing, or advertising business.
Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or another environment emphasizing rigorous analytical problem solving and executive communication.
Experience analyzing merchant, marketplace, advertising, or transaction-level economics.
Experience combining internal data with external market, competitive, consumer, or industry data to explain business performance and identify emerging trends.
Familiarity with experimentation, A/B testing, and causal analysis, including the ability to interpret results and translate them into business decisions.
Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate analytical workflows, from ad hoc investigation and deep-dive analysis to dashboard development, automation, data visualization, and communicating insights.
A demonstrated interest in emerging analytical tools and a track record of using technology to reduce time from question → analysis → insight → action.
Experience with Python or another analytical programming language. Python is helpful, but this is not a data science or machine learning role.
Familiarity with modern data infrastructure and tools such as Databricks, dbt, Spark, or similar technologies.

How You'll Succeed:

The strongest person in this role will combine the analytical depth of a senior analyst with the mindset of a business operator.

You will be successful if you can:

Spot an important change in the business before someone asks about it.
Determine which questions are worth spending time answering—and which aren't.
Turn a vague business question into a structured analytical approach.
Move comfortably between customer-level data, deal and merchant performance, financial results, and broader market trends.
Develop hypotheses and determine which analyses will actually help distinguish between competing explanations.
Distinguish an interesting data point from something that actually matters to the business.
Develop a point of view rather than simply delivering analysis.
Explain complex analytical findings simply and persuasively.
Communicate that point of view clearly enough to influence senior-level decisions.
Use emerging tools, including AI, to materially increase your analytical leverage and speed.
Build a deep understanding of how Slickdeals works and use that context to continually improve the questions we ask.

This is not a role focused primarily on producing dashboards or fulfilling a queue of analytical requests. We are looking for someone who wants to own important business questions from beginning to end and whose work will directly influence how Slickdeals operates and where we invest.

Because of the breadth of the role and its exposure to senior leadership, this position represents an opportunity to have an outsized impact on both Slickdeals' near-term performance and its long-term strategic direction.

LOCATION: San Mateo, CA

Hybrid schedule visiting our San Mateo office three days a week (Tues-Thurs).

Slickdeals Compensation, Benefits, Perks:

The expected base pay for this role is between $153,000 - $186,000. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Exact compensation will be discussed during the interview process and tailored to the candidate's qualifications.

Competitive base salary, annual bonus, and equity package
Competitive paid time off in addition to holiday time off
A variety of healthcare insurance plans to give you the best care for your needs
401K matching above the industry standard
Professional Development Reimbursement Program

Work Authorization

Slickdeals will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with the "Ban the Box" legislation. We may access publicly available information as part of your application.

Description

Actual compensation may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, geographical location, and internal alignment.

Summary

In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing data to support manufacturing processes and business operations. Your expertise in data collection, analysis, visualization, ERP system customization, and stakeholder communication will be crucial in ensuring data-driven decision making across production operations and business functions. You will work with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into analytical solutions, customize ERP systems to optimize business processes, and provide actionable insights to drive organizational performance.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Inventory, Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, and Operations, to understand data requirements and develop data-driven cost reduction strategies and process optimization initiatives.

Stay updated on industry trends, new analytical tools, and advancements in data science and business intelligence.
All other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related quantitative field.

Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Excel fundamentals for data extraction and manipulation.
Basic programming knowledge for software development and system integration.
